system.description:
Lore: Relic Staff (Bound)

Avarice keeps it close, and the cold that clings to it is noticeably worse than the weather outside. It has the following Powers:

  • (+2) Trinket: Deals an extra +2 damage with Cold Spells.
  • Resistance: Favor on Saves and damage reduction against Cold.
  • Winter's Reach: Holds 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.PHrsI0UrnCxQjjSq]{Freeze} or @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.GvDP0oYm6yPkkb6o]{Frostburn}. If it is broken while empty, it melts into water.

Value: 15000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
